fusions.name: Torpor Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds. You hold 3 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hissing Ring
fusions.desc: A hiss that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Tail
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A dropped tail fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunning Spot
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
